objective: Split a whole-pence total across parties in proportion to integer weights using the largest-remainder (Hamilton) method so the shares sum EXACTLY to the total (no penny lost or created): floor each exact quota, then award the leftover pennies one each to the parties with the largest fractional quota, breaking ties toward the lower index.

requirements.description: Shares sum exactly to totalPence for uneven proportional splits (no penny lost or created)
Leftover pennies are awarded to the largest fractional quotas (ties to the lower index); a zero weight receives nothing
Trivial and exactly-divisible splits are preserved
